usgs_hydrogeologic_regions_2025.title: Hydrogeologic regions of the conterminous United States
usgs_hydrogeologic_regions_2025.meaning: shallowest hydrogeologic region; combines Principal Aquifers and 69 Secondary Hydrogeologic Regions
limitations: do not call every polygon an aquifer
HR_Type=PA may be presented as Principal Aquifer; HR_Type=SHR must remain Secondary Hydrogeologic Region
sand-and-gravel aquifers of alluvial and glacial origin are not included

transport.selection: shard geometry bbox intersects requested map/analysis bounds
transport.failure_behavior: return unavailable; fall through to approved Principal Aquifers transition fallback

usgs_principal_aquifers.meaning: national principal-aquifer extent; regional context, not parcel boundary

usda_naip.notes: cache/reuse; prefetch only after core property analysis where useful

nasa_grace_fo.meaning: regional storage change only; not aquifer geometry or local water-table depth
